question: What is the medical term for pregnancy?
explanation: Gestation is the formal medical term used to describe the entire period of carrying a developing fetus from fertilization to birth. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T001#GNS226_U2_T001_h1)

question: When does a pregnancy biologically begin?

options.A: At the first movement felt by the mother
options.C: When the mother misses her monthly period
options.D: When the placenta is fully formed

explanation: Pregnancy officially kicks off right when a sperm meets and fertilizes an egg! Everything else follows from that tiny spark. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T001#GNS226_U2_T001_h1)

question: In which part of the female reproductive tract does fertilization usually take place?
explanation: The fallopian tube, specifically the ampulla section, is the normal site where sperm and egg meet and fertilize. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T001#GNS226_U2_T001_h2)

question: What happens right after a single sperm successfully enters an egg?

options.B: The embryo immediately implants into the ovary
options.C: The mother's hormone levels drop sharply
options.D: The egg blocks other sperm from entering

explanation: Smart egg! To keep everything balanced, the egg instantly changes its outer layer so no other sperm can squeeze in. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T001#GNS226_U2_T001_h2)

question: What is the name of the hollow ball of cells that travels down to plant itself in the uterus?
explanation: By the time it's ready to nestle into the uterine lining, the tiny group of cells is called a blastocyst. You're doing brilliantly! [learn more](GNS226_U2_T001#GNS226_U2_T001_h3)

question: Why is the hormone hCG so important right after a fertilized egg implants?

options.A: It triggers the immediate onset of active labor contractions
options.B: It stimulates the rapid production of red blood cells
options.C: It keeps progesterone levels up so the uterine lining stays strong
options.D: It directly causes morning sickness in the expectant mother

explanation: hCG acts like a cheerleader for the corpus luteum, telling it to keep pumping out progesterone so the womb stays cozy and ready for the baby. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T001#GNS226_U2_T001_h3)

question: How many weeks does a normal, full-term human pregnancy typically last?
explanation: A standard full-term gestation spans about 40 weeks from the start of the last menstrual period, or roughly 38 weeks from actual fertilization. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T001#GNS226_U2_T001_h4)

question: During which stage of pregnancy do the baby's main organs first form?
explanation: The first trimester is a super busy time when all the major body organs are being built. That's why it's such a delicate period! [learn more](GNS226_U2_T001#GNS226_U2_T001_h4)

question: Why does a pregnant woman's body make a lot more blood?

options.A: To lower her core body temperature
options.B: To make up for heavy monthly bleeding
options.C: To prevent swollen veins in her legs
options.D: To supply the growing placenta and baby

explanation: A pregnant body increases its blood volume to make sure the placenta and the growing baby get all the oxygen and nutrients they need. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T001#GNS226_U2_T001_h5)

question: Why do pregnant women often get heartburn and feel constipated?

options.A: Liver enzymes stop working for the first few months
options.B: The growing baby blocks food from being digested properly
options.C: A pregnancy hormone relaxes the muscles in the digestive tract
options.D: Stomach acid suddenly turns ten times stronger

explanation: Blame progesterone! It relaxes smooth muscles all over the body, which slows down digestion and leads to common issues like heartburn. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T001#GNS226_U2_T001_h5)

question: Which of these is a POSITIVE, 100% sure sign of pregnancy?

options.D: Hearing the baby's heartbeat on an ultrasound

explanation: When you actually hear or see that little heartbeat on an ultrasound, there's no guessing anymore—that's a confirmed pregnancy! [learn more](GNS226_U2_T001#GNS226_U2_T001_h6)

question: What is the main difference between presumptive and probable signs of pregnancy?

options.A: Probable signs only show up right before birth
options.B: Presumptive signs are things the mother feels herself, while probable signs are things a nurse or doctor observes
options.C: Presumptive signs mean the baby is healthy, while probable signs mean trouble
options.D: Presumptive signs need lab tests, while probable signs need X-rays

explanation: Think of presumptive as what the client experiences (like nausea) and probable as what we find during our physical checks as clinicians! [learn more](GNS226_U2_T001#GNS226_U2_T001_h6)
